product.name: Biometric Authentication on All Platforms
product.description: Enables user authentication using biometric data on devices with biometric capabilities or via QR code scanning on non-biometric devices.

product.name: Fraud Prevention Platform
product.description: Provides event tracking, intelligence, and risk analytics to detect and manage fraud throughout the user journey from registration to login and beyond.

product.name: QR Login
product.description: Allows users to log in to web applications by scanning a QR code and authenticating with biometrics on their mobile device or mobile browser.

product.name: Platform Biometrics
product.description: Enables users to authenticate using built-in biometric features on their computers for secure, input-free login.

identifier.value: Deep Linking with Dynamic QR Codes

product.name: Deep Linking with Dynamic QR Codes
product.description: Uses dynamic QR codes to automatically log in existing app users or direct new users to app download pages.

product.name: Risk Analytics
product.description: Analyzes location data, attacker databases, and proxy detection to prevent phishing, malware, and spoofing attacks during authentication.
